displayName: Azure Machine Learning online endpoints should use Microsoft Entra ID authentication
description: Audit Azure Machine Learning managed online endpoints whose authMode is not AADToken. Key-based and Azure ML token (AMLToken) endpoints are reported. Does not check who holds data-plane roles, or serverless and batch endpoints. Audit is the default.

builtInReview.gap: No live built-in among 2862 definitions checks the authentication mode of Azure Machine Learning online endpoints. B10 covers compute local authentication only.

metadata.description: Audit reports online endpoints that do not use Microsoft Entra ID tokens. Deny is available only for a separate explicit assignment.
